game_concept: A puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel, an old mine cart tunnel: the torchbearer must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel: an old mine cart tunnel
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Archive variation 7: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for B and Unix.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the mine cart is reached, or lives reach 0.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Guess Until Right' (Week 4 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Mine Cart Tunnel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guess_range changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Mine Cart Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The mine cart reached with actions_used <= 19.
source_player_objective: Reach the mine cart using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The mine cart reached with actions_used <= 19.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the mine cart is reached, or lives reach 0.
